__comment: Terra inputs, pointing at the Lemieux/Anahtar sandbox workspace bucket (terra-b801b1b8). Everything must be a gs:// URI — Cromwell on Terra cannot read local paths.
__comment_assemblies: Upload the test assemblies to the bucket first: gcloud storage cp tests/test_data/*.fna gs://fc-dd942a2f-eb3d-466c-994b-240989a62a4b/workspace_data/test_assemblies/
__comment_busco: 'auto' places each assembly in the prokaryote tree independently — worth exercising here, since Borrelia and E. coli should resolve to different lineages (spirochaetales vs enterobacterales). If they don't, auto-lineage resolution is misbehaving.
__comment_checkm2: The CheckM2 DIAMOND reference database (~2.9 GB), staged once in the bucket. Passed as a raw uncompressed .dmnd — the task hands it straight to --database_path, so do not tar or gzip it. Omitting this input makes every scattered shard download its own 3 GB copy.
__comment_first_run: This is CheckM2's first real execution — it has never run end-to-end. QUAST and BUSCO are already verified. Expected failure modes are loud (bad flag, missing column), not silently wrong numbers.
